crossRefs.note: Then a wise woman cried out of the city, “Hear, hear! Please say to Joab, ‘Come near here, that I may speak with you.’ ”
Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city.
I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.

translations.web: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.
translations.bsb: A wise man scales the city of the mighty and pulls down the stronghold in which they trust.
translations.kjv: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence
translations.asv: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, And bringeth down the strength of the confidence thereof.
